summary: Crypto sentiment is cautiously bullish but highly volatile: Michaël van de Poppe sees a potential Bitcoin breakout above $82,000 toward $90,000, while warning of a possible false move and weekend liquidity stress.[5][7] Ethereum also has a long-term bullish breakout thesis, but recent selling and liquidations increase near-term risk.[8] The available results do not provide verified same-day commentary for most requested assets, equities, FX, commodities, or additional altcoins.
